lessons.title: Going to for Future Plans
lessons.content: 'Going to' is used to talk about plans and intentions for the future. The structure is Subject + am/is/are + going to + V1.

details.explanation: 'Going to' is used when we have already decided to do something in the future.
details.example: I am going to play football with my friends.
details.burmese: ငါ သူငယ်ချင်းတွေနဲ့ ဘောလုံး ကစားတော့မယ်။

details.explanation: 'Going to' is used to talk about another person's future plans.
details.example: The baby is going to sleep.
details.burmese: ကလေး အိပ်တော့မယ်။

details.explanation: 'Going to' is used for actions that are already scheduled or arranged.
details.example: She is going to visit her grandmother next week.
details.burmese: သူမ နောက်အပတ်မှာ အဘိုးအဘွားဆီ သွားလည်မယ်။

details.explanation: 'Going to' is used when a group has a plan together.
details.example: We are going to have a meeting tomorrow.
details.burmese: ငါတို့ မနက်ဖြန် အစည်းအဝေး လုပ်မယ်။

lessons.title: Going to for Predictions
lessons.content: 'Going to' is used to make predictions based on what we can see now — present evidence. The structure is Subject + am/is/are + going to + V1.

details.explanation: 'Going to' is used when we predict something based on how we feel now.
details.example: I think I am going to be sick.
details.burmese: ငါ အန်မယ်ဖြစ်တော့မယ်လို့ ထင်တယ်။

details.explanation: 'Going to' can be used in questions to ask about future predictions.
details.example: Are you going to take a bath?

details.explanation: 'Going to' is used when we can see something that tells us what will happen.
details.example: Look at those dark clouds. It is going to rain.

details.explanation: 'Going to' is used when we can see someone's expression or behavior.
details.example: She is going to cry. Look at her face.
details.burmese: သူမ ငိုတော့မယ်။ မျက်နှာကြည့်ပါ။
